newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ThermoTrex rating affirmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ThermoTrex rating affirmed.

text.p: - Barrington Research Associates Inc analyst Michael Hutchison reiterated the firm's long-term outperform rating for ThermoTrex Corp, a San Diego-based developer of mammography equipment and other technology used to detect breast cancer.
- ThermoTrex's fourth-quarter revenues jumped 66 percent to $53.5 million, mainly because of recent acquisitions, Hutchison said.
- The company is also poised to enter the hair-removal business, a move that is expected to hold down earnings visibility, Hutchison said.
